# Version 3.119.3
> **Runtime and native updates** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/3.119.3-preview.1.1)

> **Superseded by [3.119.4](3.119.4.md)** · Never released as stable — these changes rolled up into 3.119.4.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](3.119.3/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.1.4/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.119.3 Preview 1 fixes Ahead-of-Time deployment and refreshes bundled native dependencies. It also corrects Linux ARM64 font configuration and adds native binary hardening for supported Windows and Linux builds.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Ahead-of-Time applications start correctly** — Fixes a crash when publishing with IlcDisableReflection enabled. ([#3485](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3485))
- **Linux ARM64 font support corrected** — Adds the required fontconfig runtime library to the cross-compilation sysroot. ([#3494](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3494))

## Security

- **Native libraries and dependencies refreshed** — Updates libpng, libwebp, libexpat, and brotli while enabling native binary mitigation flags. — ❤️ [@sshumakov](https://github.com/sshumakov) ([#3452](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3452), [#3458](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3458), [#3469](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3469), [#3478](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3478), [#3496](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3496), [#3502](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3502))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.4

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
